decision_table.name: Determine_TN_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file TN franchise and excise tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in TN (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets TN economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required for both taxes // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to physical presence in Tennessee.
Both taxes apply: 1. Franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth (greater of book value or property) 2. Excise tax: 6.5% on net earnings (apportioned income)
Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax) Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax) Reference: Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return) Reference: TN Revenue Ruling 07-24 (Physical presence nexus)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in TN.
Economic nexus applies to both franchise and excise taxes.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007(b) (Economic nexus) Reference: TN Notice 20-11 (Marketplace Facilitator Act and Economic Nexus)
No TN nexus - no filing requirement for franchise or excise tax. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_TN_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate TN state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
TN state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions include: - Interest on federal obligations (U.S. Treasury bonds, etc.) - IRC § 199A qualified business income deduction addback - State franchise and excise taxes paid (not deductible)
Subtractions include: - Interest on TN state and local bonds - Dividends from 80%+ owned subsidiaries - TN NOL carryforward deduction
Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2006 (Definitions of net earnings) Reference: Form FAE 170 Instructions (Schedule J - Adjustments) Reference: TN Revenue Ruling 09-13 (IRC conformity)
No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_TN_Franchise_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate TN franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth. Net worth is the greater of book value or property value in TN.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe franchise tax

condition.name: has_net_worth
condition.comment: Has positive net worth in TN

rule.policy:
TN franchise tax calculation:
1. Determine net worth: Greater of: - Book value (capital stock + surplus + undivided profits) - Fair market value of property owned/used in TN
2. Apply franchise tax rate: Net worth × 0.25%
3. Combined minimum tax (franchise + excise): $100
The franchise tax is separate from and in addition to the excise tax.
Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax rate) Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2111 (Determination of net worth) Reference: Form FAE 170 Schedule F (Franchise Tax Calculation) Reference: TN Revenue Ruling 17-01 (Net worth valuation methods)

actions.action: // No net worth - franchise tax is zero result.tn_franchise_tax = 0.0;

rule.policy: No net worth in TN - no franchise tax liability. Excise tax may still apply if there is net earnings.
No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability.

decision_table.name: Calculate_TN_Excise_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate TN excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned net earnings. Combines with franchise tax for total TN tax liability.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe excise tax

rule.policy:
TN franchise and excise tax calculation:
EXCISE TAX (6.5% on net earnings): 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. TN additions: + [Table 51920] 3. TN subtractions: - [Table 51920] 4. TN taxable income before apportionment: = [Subtotal] 5. Apportioned to TN: × [Single-sales factor %] 6. TN taxable income: = [Result] 7. Excise tax rate: × 6.5% 8. Excise tax before credits: = [Tax] 9. TN credits: - [Credits] 10. TN excise tax: = [Final excise tax]
FRANCHISE TAX (0.25% on net worth): 11. TN net worth: [From table 51960] 12. Franchise tax rate: × 0.25% 13. TN franchise tax: = [Franchise tax]
TOTAL TAX: 14. Combined tax: Excise tax + Franchise tax 15. Minimum tax: $100 16. TN total tax: = Greater of combined or minimum
Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax rate: 6.5%) Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax rate: 0.25%) Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2006 (Net earnings definition) Reference: Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return) Reference: TN Revenue Ruling 10-22 (Single-sales apportionment)
No TN net earnings - no excise tax liability. Franchise tax still applies if there is net worth. Minimum tax ($100) applies if franchise tax is owed.
No TN nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
